page-title.purpose: Names the current import queue. Fluid between 34 and 54px.

record-title.purpose: Names the selected record. Fluid between 26 and 36px.

book-title.purpose: Identifies a book within the queue.

count.purpose: Aligns tabular totals inside the status strip.

metadata.purpose: Shows evidence and supporting record details.

section-title.purpose: Labels record groups such as metadata and import history.

destination-path.purpose: Keeps the proposed filesystem path readable and selectable.

shadows.name: book-mark-spine
shadows.purpose: Defines the spine edge of the brand mark.

shadows.name: book-cover
shadows.purpose: Distinguishes the spine and silhouette of a small queue thumbnail.

components.name: Approval Button
components.description: Confirms the import after the destination preview.
components.css: .ds-approval { border-radius: 4px; padding: 10px 17px; font: 600 12px "DM Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; background: #d8ac70; color: #1b1410; border: 1px solid #d8ac70; width: 100%; padding: 13px; } .ds-approval:hover { background: #efc78f; } .ds-approval:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d8ac70; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-approval:disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: default; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Handles utility actions such as refreshing the review desk.
components.css: .ds-secondary { border-radius: 4px; padding: 10px 17px; font: 600 12px "DM Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; background: #2c2019; color: #ecdcc2; border: 1px solid #654b3b; } .ds-secondary:hover { background: #433025; } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d8ac70; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-secondary:disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: default; }

components.name: Import Search
components.description: Searches the register by title, author, or filename.
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"><circle cx="6.5" cy="6.5" r="4"/><path d="m9.5 9.5 3 3"/></svg><input aria-label="Search imports" placeholder="Search by title, author, or filename"></label>
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; background: #2c2019; color: #ecdcc2; border: 1px solid #654b3b; border-radius: 4px; padding: 9px 14px; max-width: 480px; } .ds-search svg { flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-search input { border: 0; outline: none; background: transparent; min-width: 0; width: 100%; color: inherit; font: 400 12px "DM Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: #c2aa90; opacity: 1; } .ds-search:focus-within { outline: 2px solid #d8ac70; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Import Status Tags
components.description: Pairs each state with a text label and its own fill and text colors.
components.html: Needs review Saving to library Imported Needs attention
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-block; border-radius: 4px; padding: 4px 7px; background: #433025; color: #ecdcc2; font: 600 9px "DM Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-review { background: #512f19; color: #f0c38a; } .ds-working { background: #2b3645; color: #cadcf3; } .ds-imported { background: #2b4034; color: #c3dfc5; } .ds-attention { background: #492820; color: #ffcec0; }

components.name: Current Import Filter
components.description: Keeps the current status filter visible in the sidebar.
components.css: .ds-nav { padding: 8px; background: #2c2019; } .ds-filter { display: flex; width: 100%; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 13px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 3px; background: transparent; color: #ecdcc2; text-align: left; font: 400 13px "DM Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-filter:hover, .ds-filter[aria-current] { background: #433025; } .ds-filter[aria-current] { color: #d8ac70; font-weight: 700; } .ds-filter:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d8ac70; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #b48a4e; } .ds-queued { background: #a7b1a8; } .ds-count { margin-left: auto; min-width: 22px; text-align: center; border-radius: 4px; padding: 3px; font-size: 11px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; background: #433025; }

components.name: Selected Queue Record
components.description: Marks the record open in the adjacent detail pane.
components.css: .ds-record { display: flex; position: relative; align-items: flex-start; gap: 16px; width: 100%; padding: 22px 18px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #654b3b; background: #1b1410; color: #ecdcc2; font: 400 12px "DM Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-record:hover, .ds-record[aria-pressed="true"] { background: #433025; } .ds-record[aria-pressed="true"]::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 16px auto 16px 0; width: 3px; border-radius: 0 2px 2px 0; background: #d8ac70; } .ds-record:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d8ac70; outline-offset: 2px; outline-offset: -3px; } .ds-cover { display: flex; flex: 0 0 44px; height: 62px; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center; gap: 10px; border-radius: 2px 4px 4px 2px; background: #614037; box-shadow: inset 3px 0 #0004, 2px 3px 6px #0005; font: 24px Georgia, serif; } .ds-cover small { font: 400 7px "DM Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 1px; } .ds-record-text { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; min-width: 0; color: #c2aa90; } .ds-record-text strong { color: #ecdcc2; font: 18px/1.2 Georgia, serif; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-record-text small { font-size: 10px; } .ds-record-state { align-self: flex-start; margin-top: 5px; padding: 4px 7px; border-radius: 4px; background: #512f19; color: #f0c38a; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Metadata Choice
components.description: Keeps the source and evidence visible alongside a native radio option.
components.css: .ds-candidate { display: flex; gap: 10px; padding: 14px; border: 1px solid #654b3b; border-radius: 4px; background: #2c2019; color: #ecdcc2; font: 400 12px/1.6 "DM Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; color-scheme: dark; } .ds-candidate:has(:checked) { background: #433025; border-color: #d8ac70; } .ds-candidate input { align-self: flex-start; margin: 3px 0 0; accent-color: #d8ac70; } .ds-candidate input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d8ac70; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-evidence { display: grid; flex: 1; min-width: 0; gap: 5px; color: #c2aa90; } .ds-candidate-top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; gap: 10px; } .ds-candidate-top strong { color: #ecdcc2; font-size: 14px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-candidate-top small { padding: 3px 5px; border: 1px solid #654b3b; border-radius: 3px; background: #1b1410; font-size: 9px; }

components.name: Destination Preview
components.description: Shows the full proposed destination directly above approval.
components.html: DESTINATION PREVIEWResearch/H. G. Wells/The Time Machine/The Time Machine - H. G. Wells [abc123].epubThe original file will be retained.
components.css: .ds-destination { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; padding: 17px; border: 1px solid #654b3b; border-radius: 4px; background: #1b1410; color: #ecdcc2; font-family: "DM Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-destination strong { color: #c2aa90; font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 1.5px; } .ds-destination code { font: 12px/1.8 monospace; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-destination small { color: #c2aa90; font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.6; }

narrative.overview:
Paparr’s imports and review desk is the first implementation of Accession Ledger. Walnut and espresso surfaces recall a library desk. Parchment type and thin rules make filenames, metadata evidence, and destinations easy to compare. Serif book titles and clothbound initials bring in the library reference while keeping the register compact.

The imports sidebar shares this treatment while the review desk is open. The sign-in, library health, and worker status views retain their existing styling. The review desk stylesheet and shared base styles are the implementation sources. `@src/Paparr.UI/src/accession-ledger.css` and `@src/Paparr.UI/src/index.css`
keyCharacteristics: Espresso and walnut planes divided by thin rules
Parchment text, serif titles, and compact sans-serif controls
Brass selection markers and approval controls
Small clothbound book initials in the queue

rules.name: The Brass Rule
rules.body: Use solid brass for the main action and narrow brass details for selection and focus.

dos: Do give book titles the serif hierarchy and use sans-serif for metadata and controls.
Do keep status words and a visible keyboard outline alongside color cues.
Do set destination paths beside the action that publishes to them.
donts: Don't add raised shadows to panels or navigation.
Don't use the brass fill for routine secondary controls.
